findings.claim: The ruling block was never adversarially reviewed. Article IV assigns L5 to sidefx-cto followed by crucible; only the first ran. The 18 items are one model's unattacked judgement.

Ruling-block R11 ranks the WS bridge defect above the entire relay. That finding (L1.F1) is false - the bridge was healthy; the probe omitted the /synapse path and read nine HTTP 400 path rejections as nine transport failures. R11 must be re-ranked before the block is read.

Ruling-block item on emergency halt (from L3.R2) is wrong. A Stop button exists in the live rail at synapse_panel.py:441 and _on_stop is honest by Law 3. The real gap is narrower: in-flight cook cancel is deferred, and EmergencyProtocol is unreachable. See R29.

Two ruling surfaces exist and were never reconciled: this relay's CTO_RELAY_01_RULING.md (18 items) and CTO_RULINGS_01.md (29 rulings, written concurrently by the orchestrator on the same branch). L4.F5 flagged the concurrent-commit condition as a blocker at the time.

for_ruling.question: Three of the ruling block's 18 items are now known-wrong or re-ranked (R11 refuted, emergency halt refuted, plus the unsourced 39/218 corrected to a live 40/218). Re-run L5 with crucible, or annotate in place?
options: Re-run L5 end to end with crucible
Annotate the three items in place and mark the block reviewed-by-orchestrator
Leave as-is and rely on CTO_RULINGS_01.md
for_ruling.recommendation: Annotate in place. A re-run would regenerate 18 items from receipts that have themselves been partly refuted since - it would launder corrections into fresh-looking findings. Annotation preserves what was found, when, and by what evidence.
for_ruling.cost_of_delay: High for trust. Anyone reading the block today reads three wrong rankings as current.

for_ruling.question: Two ruling surfaces on one branch. Merge them, or declare one canonical?
options: CTO_RULINGS_01.md canonical, relay block becomes an appendix
for_ruling.recommendation: CTO_RULINGS_01.md canonical. It carries the corrections and the later evidence; the relay block is the record of what the legs found and should be preserved unedited as that record.
for_ruling.cost_of_delay: Medium. Two sources of truth is the F6 ID-collision failure mode wearing different clothes.
